author: reek
body: The bind must refuse it and the seam must answer the NE2000 constant. A refusal that fabricated an address instead would leave every later stage looking healthy while the card filtered out the replies, which reads on the glass as a dead cable rather than as a wrong address.

author: reek
body: The fallback address is written out here rather than taken from NetDriver. A test that imports its comparand from the chapter it is judging cannot fail when that comparand moves, and this arm asserts the seam DID answer this value, which makes the independence load-bearing in the other direction too.
